name: Stylized Rooftop Courier Key Art
purpose: Stress-test prompt-format transfer in a dense non-photographic scene whose subject, action, lighting, depth, materials, and exclusions can be represented equivalently in prose or structured syntax.
first_party_baseline_prompt: Create a polished fantasy-adventure key-art illustration showing an adult courier crossing a rain-darkened rooftop market at blue hour. She carries a folded map tube, wears a layered travel coat over practical boots, and looks toward a distant signal lantern while wind catches the coat hem. Use a three-quarter full-body view, an asymmetric composition, and clear foreground awning edges, midground character action, and background rooflines. The rendering should feel like high-end game promotional art with controlled painterly edges, selective hard highlights, coherent material separation, and a cool environment punctuated by warm lantern light. Keep the focal hierarchy clear and avoid UI, logos, captions, or decorative text.

allowed_experimental_mutation_points.description: Express the same semantic facts as natural-language production prose or JSON-style structured syntax.

provenance.notes: The prompt is newly authored for AIPF. Private source material informed mechanism selection only; source wording, prompt IDs, images, and creator-specific composition are not embedded.
